title: Wheelchair-accessible routing
summary: Comparing A*, constraint filtering and MDP planning on Brussels street graphs.
team: Fatima Ben Mostefa, Francesca Grasso, Lara Moreno & Matteo Paolini
overview: A team project compares routes that account for accessibility constraints with an unconstrained shortest-path baseline.
constraints: OpenStreetMap accessibility information is incomplete. Shared synthetic attributes were added for reproducible algorithm comparisons.
contribution: My GitHub contributions include the main benchmark integration, shared graph-attribute handling and documentation. The planning methods were team work.
approach: The approaches use soft penalties, hard constraint filtering and stochastic planning. Outputs include route maps and weather-specific benchmark tables.
results: The repository contains interactive maps, code, plots and saved benchmark results. These document an algorithmic comparison.
limits: The routes are not field-validated accessibility guidance. Synthetic attributes and a data-coverage score must not be presented as verified safety or prediction accuracy.
